notes.title: 1.9 Update
notes.content: Seemed some flickering lights were effecting performance. So those lights no longer flicker. Also I activated Lumen in Unreal Engine and tweaked some settings helping boost performance a little.

notes.title: Small Collision Patch
notes.content: Removed first note you see as camera would glitch out if the Flashlight was picked up first. Also moved player starting location slightly so Flashlight is more noticeable when play starts. Foxed bug where players would get stuck when coming down the stairs, players in the past had to move slightly to the right but now this is not necessary.

notes.title: Patch 0.02
notes.content:
In this small patch some Symbols have been added to the game to help players locate where items need to be placed to trigger events in puzzle sections of the game. Also more Achievements have been added to the game so players can show progression to their friends.
